description: Synthetic sesslint.bundle.v1 schema parity. Constraints and expected rejections come from the pinned schema. Bundle.to_json bytes are not stored. The pinned schema tests are not covered.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-bundle-schema-load: load_bundle_schema and get_bundle_schema_path read schemas/sesslint.bundle.v1.json. This card embeds the pin bytes and does not call those functions. tests/test_plan_bundle_schemas.py::test_bundle_schema_loads_and_self_consistent calls both, so it is not covered.

GAP-bundle-validate-helper: _validate_bundle_dict calls assert_schema and then extra structural checks. The other bundle tests also call build_bundle, to_dict, or to_json. One validate_json result is not that whole test.
GAP-bundle-emitter-bytes: Bundle.to_json uses json.dumps. sesslint._canonical_codec.canonical_json_bytes is not available. This card does not invent those bytes.
GAP-bundle-duplicate-key: duplicate JSON object keys are refused. Python json.loads keeps the last key.
GAP-bundle-json-number: a JSON number that is not a proven integer is not an integer. Equality of two non-integers is refused. minimum is not applied to a non-integer.
